name: goalcraft
description: Shows your goals as funnels and the AI agents working them: agents create funnels, report progress after each run and ask you questions.

interface.shortDescription: Watch AI agents craft your goals
interface.longDescription: Goalcraft is a live dashboard for the long goals you hand to AI agents: a job search, fundraising, finding customers, research. Each goal is a funnel of stages drawn as pixel-art tanks with your agents at work between them. Your agent can create a funnel, report how many items reached each stage after every run, add results, show whether it is working or asleep until its next run, and ask you a question when it needs a decision; you answer from any device. Goalcraft keeps only counts, dates, links and the agents' questions; the items stay in your own sources.
defaultPrompt: What goals do I have in Goalcraft?
Create a Goalcraft funnel for my job search.

positive.prompt: What goals do I have in Goalcraft?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize each funnel: its stages with counts, results, goal and open questions.

positive.prompt: Create a Goalcraft funnel for finding podcast guests: found, contacted, replied, booked; the result is a recorded episode, goal 4, one every 14 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Create the funnel with four stages and confirm; it appears on the dashboard.

positive.prompt: I contacted 12 more podcasts today and 3 replied; report it to Goalcraft.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current counts, then report the new cumulative counts for the contacted and replied stages.

positive.prompt: We booked a guest: add a result to the podcast funnel.
positive.expected_behavior: Add one result to the podcast funnel and confirm the new total.

positive.prompt: Ask me on Goalcraft whether to accept the Tuesday slot, then wait for my answer.
positive.expected_behavior: Post the question on the dashboard, wait for the answer, then send a short reply about what happens next.

negative.prompt: Send an email to my landlord.

review.commerce_description: Goalcraft tools do not sell products or take payments. The Pro plan is bought on goalcraft.ai, outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First public release: funnels, progress reports, results, agent states and questions to the person.
